namespace = cwp_indochina

# Cold War Project: the Indochina war (je_cwp_indochina_war)
# Generated by gen_events.py in the decolonization thread's scratchpad; edit freely.

cwp_indochina.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_indochina.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indochina.1.d_fra
				trigger = { c:FRA ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indochina.1.d_dai
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indochina.1.f_fra
				trigger = { c:FRA ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indochina.1.f_dai
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_jungle_expedition"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	option = {
		name = cwp_indochina.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_indochina.1.b_fra
		trigger = { c:FRA ?= ROOT }
		if = { limit = { exists = c:DAI NOT = { c:DAI = ROOT } } change_relations = { country = c:DAI value = 20 } }
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
}

cwp_indochina.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_indochina.2.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indochina.2.d_viet
				trigger = { c:DAI ?= { has_modifier = cwp_indochina_offensive_momentum } }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indochina.2.d_french
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indochina.2.f_viet
				trigger = { c:DAI ?= { has_modifier = cwp_indochina_offensive_momentum } }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indochina.2.f_french
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_battlefield_trenches"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	option = {
		name = cwp_indochina.2.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_indochina.2.b_fra
		trigger = { c:FRA ?= ROOT }
		add_treasury = cwp_choice_cost
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_indochina.2.c_fra
		trigger = { c:FRA ?= ROOT }
		if = { limit = { exists = c:USA NOT = { c:USA = ROOT } } change_relations = { country = c:USA value = 15 } }
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
}

cwp_indochina.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_indochina.3.t
	desc = cwp_indochina.3.d
	flavor = cwp_indochina.3.f

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_battlefield_trenches"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	option = {
		name = cwp_indochina.3.a
		default_option = yes
		# Vanilla raj pattern (events/british_raj_events.txt): the subject opens an independence play on its overlord.
		create_diplomatic_play = {
			name = cwp_indochina_resistance_war
			target_country = c:FRA
			type = dp_independence
			add_war_goal = {
				holder = c:FRA
				target_country = ROOT
				type = annex_country
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = { liberty_desire >= 85 }
				add = 40
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = { has_modifier = cwp_foreign_military_aid }
				add = 20
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_indochina.3.b
		add_liberty_desire = -10
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = {
				trigger = { liberty_desire >= 85 }
				factor = 0.25
			}
		}
	}
}
